sentences.en: I don't want consolation; I simply want to be alone.
sentences.zh: 我不想要安慰；我只是想一个人待着。

sentences.en: It is a consolation that no one was killed.
sentences.zh: 至少没有人丧生，这是唯一的安慰。

sentences.en: I didn't win, but at least I got a consolation prize.
sentences.zh: 我没有赢得比赛，但至少得到了一个安慰奖。

senses.zh: 安慰，慰问,起安慰作用的人（或事物）
